description:
Estimate whether an undercut is viable for the attacker against the target.

Args:
    session_key: OpenF1 session identifier.
    attacker_number: Attacking driver's race number.
    target_number: Target driver's race number.
    current_lap: Current lap number in the race.

Returns:
    data: {laps_to_clear, viable, marginal}.
    meta.gap_to_target_s: attacker-minus-target race time at current_lap.
    meta.gap_source: "cumulative_lap_time", or "default" (assumed 2.0 s, also
        in meta.assumed_gap_s) when either driver lacks a full lap history.
    meta.estimated: true.

current_lap.description: Current lap number in the race.
current_lap.title: Current Lap

name: f1_undercut_window
